text: A computation can do exactly three things. Which is NOT one of them?
choices: Reach a designated final state and stop
Produce a result without changing state
Cycle, returning to a state it has been in before
explanation: Halting, cycling, and running on are the complete list. Producing a result is not a fourth option — it is what reaching a final state means. In Unit VIII we will find that deciding which of the three will happen, in general, is impossible.
